title: Tensor Network Methods for Advection-Diffusion-Reaction Systems Using Quantum-Inspired Representations
summary: We present a quantum-inspired tensor-network framework for solving advection-diffusion-reaction (ADR) partial differential equations. Discretized solution fields are encoded as matrix product states (MPS), while differential operators are represented as matrix product operators (MPOs). Time integration is performed entirely in tensor-network form using explicit Euler updates with controlled truncation.
